prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A young man stands in a brightly lit supermarket, captured mid-moment as he reads a piece of paper with an expression of surprise and excitement. He wears a light blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark tie, and black-rimmed glasses, giving him a casual yet slightly professional appearance. His dark hair is slightly tousled, and he holds a brown paper grocery bag filled with snacks, including a visible bag of chips, tucked under one arm. 

To his right, a vibrant blue lottery ticket vending machine stands prominently, adorned with the bold yellow text “ARE YOU MY LUCKY WINNER?” and rows of scratch-off tickets displayed behind clear panels. The background is softly blurred, filled with the colorful shapes of produce and grocery items, evoking the lively atmosphere of a busy supermarket. 

The color palette is vivid and saturated, with the blue of the man’s shirt and the vending machine contrasting against the warm, inviting tones of the store’s interior. The lighting is even and natural, suggesting overhead fluorescent lights typical of a grocery store, with no harsh shadows. The camera angle is at eye level, focusing closely on the man’s upper body and face, capturing his genuine reaction and the details of his surroundings. The overall style is cinematic and slightly whimsical, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the viewer’s attention on the subject while softly blending the background into a pleasant bokeh. The mood is lighthearted and filled with anticipation, as if the man has just discovered he might be a lottery winner.
